protocol.corpora: corpora.tsv: name, role, sentence; the last two sentences of each corpus are role=test and are never used to build centroids, lexicons, or calibration
protocol.nearest_corpus: each test sentence queries all corpus centroids (mean of train sentences); top-1/top-3 exact match to its own corpus
protocol.separability: per corpus: leave-one-out distance of each train sentence to the centroid of the others, vs 512 negative train sentences from other corpora sampled with xorshift64 seeded 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 ^ (corpus_index * 0xD1B54A32D192ED03); separable at (accept, reject) if the ceil(accept*n)-th smallest in-domain distance <= the floor((1-reject)*m)-th smallest negative distance - 1e-4
protocol.questions: questions.tsv: name, question; 5 per corpus written by the 27B teacher (Mistral-Small-3.2-24B served as 'held') from five train sentences only, never a test sentence; every question queries all centroids like a test sentence. For the router-level eval the first 2 questions per corpus are queries and the remaining ones are calibration probes.
protocol.transformers: embedding caches under cache/ hold float16 centroids, test/question embeddings and per-corpus sorted distance lists; regenerated by make vsa_routing_arena_embed when the model is served
protocol.distilled: cache/qwen3-embedding-4b/vocab_pca256w.npz: the 10,795 train-vocabulary stems (most frequent surface form per stem) embedded once as single words by Qwen3-Embedding-4B, centred, PCA to 256 whitened components (float16). make vsa_routing_arena regenerates the DSTL context file from it with a seeded +-1/sqrt(256) projection into 2048-d (tools/cnet_vsa_lexicon_distill.py --from-pca) and builds the lex_distilled row: context = 0.5*random-indexing + 0.5*distilled, beta 1.0, 16 PCs removed. No transformer runs at query time.
protocol.training: questions_train.tsv: name, question; 5 new questions per corpus written by the live teacher (port 8081, a Qwen-based 8B) from train sentences only, with the frozen evaluation questions shown as 'already written, do not repeat'; exact and near duplicates (Jaccard >= 0.8 on content words) of evaluation questions removed. Used ONLY by the lex_trained row (cnet_vsa_lexicon_train: question terms move toward the corpus centroid, away from the hardest other one). The evaluation questions and test sentences are never trained on.
protocol.phrases_subwords: lex_full: the distilled-word lexicon plus 8192 learned adjacent-word phrases (Random Indexing only; distilled phrase vectors measured worse and are not used) and learned character n-gram subword backoff (n 3-5, n-grams in 4..40 vocabulary words, half weight) for words absent from the table.
protocol.post_freeze: frozen_model.json pins the digests of every table the gate rebuilds; the checker fails if a rebuilt digest differs. questions_fresh_20260912.tsv: 88 questions written AFTER the freeze by Claude (the assistant, not a human) in a deliberately non-teacher style (colloquial, indirect, typos; 48 of them target the distinguishing side of 24 confusable sibling pairs). Scored as the 'post-freeze' block by bin/cnet_vsa_arena --extra-questions and tools/cnet_vsa_arena_transformer.py --extra-questions; reported, never trained on, not frozen into expected.json. questions_human.tsv (same format, '#' comments allowed) is the place for a human-written set; nothing about the model may change after it is written.
protocol.training_v2: questions_train_v2.tsv: 15,692 pairs over 5,760 paraphrase families, all from training sources: the 5,326 v3 teacher questions; colloquial paraphrases (casual search-box question + plain-words description) of 3 of them per corpus; everyday descriptions of 2 corpus sentences per corpus; sibling contrast pairs for 400 confusable capsule pairs and polysemy contrast pairs for everyday words with different senses in unrelated capsules, each with the contrasting capsule as an explicit negative (third column). Written by the local teacher on port 8081. The trainer also pairs 16 corpus sentences per corpus (technical register).
protocol.evaluation_untouched: questions_colloquial_eval.tsv (1,877): colloquial paraphrases of the first frozen evaluation question per corpus; questions_contrast_eval.tsv (549): contrast questions for a held-out 30% of confusable pairs (including the 24 regression pairs) and a held-out 30% of polysemous words, third column = the contrasting capsule. Paraphrase families are disjoint from every training family; near-duplicates of frozen evaluation questions removed. Never trained on; reported, not frozen.
protocol.alternates: alternates.tsv: 51 directed capsule pairs where a question meant for the first may be correctly routed to the second. Candidates were MUTUAL top-3 centroid neighbours under BOTH the untrained CNET lexicon and Qwen3-4B with Qwen cosine >= 0.90 (948 candidates); the local teacher judged each from three sentences of each collection and kept 51. Every scorer applies the same file: top1_lenient = top-1 in {gold} + alternates.
protocol.independent_set: questions_indep_mistral_20260912.tsv: written after the v3.2 freeze by Mistral-Small-3.2-24B (a different model family from the Ternary-Bonsai-27B that wrote the training paraphrases) from HELD-OUT sources only: everyday questions from the two held-out sentences of 600 corpora, held-out confusable pairs, held-out polysemous words; per-question alternates judged by the same model and applied to every system. Reported, never trained on.
protocol.independent_set_control: questions_indep_mistral_mid_20260912.tsv: same writer and everyday register as the independent set, but written from train sentences at positions no training pair or paraphrase used (400 corpora): separates content position from register. Reported, never trained on.
protocol.cross_writer: questions_eval_{mistral,gemma}_everyday.tsv: 600 everyday questions each, written after the v3.2 freeze by Mistral-Small-3.2-24B and gemma4 (thinking off) from the two HELD-OUT sentences of the same 600 sampled corpora; per-question alternates judged by Mistral, applied to every system. questions_train_v3_{bm,bg,all}.tsv: v2 training families plus each writer's casual rewrites of the teacher training questions and everyday questions from 4 unused corpus sentences per corpus (bm = +Mistral, bg = +gemma, all = both). Used only for the cross-writer experiment (result/cnet_vsa_lexicon_register_training_20260912.md); the shipped gate model stays trained on questions_train_v2.tsv.
